Yes — damaged items are handled differently from a normal return.
Damaged items:
• You’ll need to provide photos of the damage and the full item, plus your order details.
• The photos are reviewed to determine the appropriate resolution.
• Return or exchange fees are covered, including shipping or pickup costs.
Normal returns:
• Must be requested within 7 days of delivery.
• A 10% restocking fee may apply, and pickup fees can also apply.
So damaged items are reviewed with photos and typically don’t include the standard return fees that apply to regular returns.
